title: Pricing repackaging go-to-market checklist and release coordination
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Purpose: Coordinate cross-functional launch activities for the 2026 pricing repackaging initiative. This ticket consolidates the go-to-market checklist: SKU definitions, default limits and quota migration strategy, billing and invoicing communications, developer console copy and UX updates, SDK/SDK docs, release notes, sales enablement collateral, and monitoring for revenue/regression signals.

Scope and deliverables:
- Finalize SKU mapping and canonical naming to appear in Console, Billing, and API docs.
- Define default quotas and opt-in migration path for existing customers; create fallback and opt-out policies.
- Author billing communication plan (pre-notice, migration window, one-click opt-out flow, and billing FAQ).
- Coordinate release notes across engineering, docs, and support with a single canonical set of bullets and PR link.
- Prepare sales enablement kit: cheat sheets, objection-handling guide, T-shirt numbers for common customer profiles, and handoff deck.
- Update Console UI copy, limits UI, and rate-limit error messaging with link to KB.
- Ensure backend metering and quota enforcement readiness with ENG and QA signoff.
- Define monitoring dashboards and burn-rate alerts for the first 30 days post-launch.

Success criteria:
- SKU catalog published and referenced in Console and API docs at GA.
- 95% of migrating customers complete within migration window without billing disputes.
- No critical revenue regression (<2% discrepancy) in the first billing cycle attributed to packaging.
- Support ticket spike mitigated by published KB and proactive comms.

Stakeholders:
- PM: Priya Patel (owner), Product Ops: Morgan Chen, Sales Enablement: Elena Novak, Billing/Finance: Omar Hassan, Engineering: Diego Ramirez (owner for rollout), Design: Samira Gupta, Docs: Lucas Wright, Support Lead: Aisha Thompson.

Key links and artifacts: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pricing/repack-2026 (canonical PRD), Google Drive: Sales Kit (drive link), GitHub: PRs for billing changes (link to PR #1127), Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/pricing-2026.01.

Launch timeline (high level):
- 2025-10-21: Kickoff and draft SKU list (complete)
- 2025-10-28: Billing migration design review (complete)
- 2025-11-05: Console copy and limits UI ready for staging testing (this ticket updated)
- 2025-11-12: Sales enablement dry-run and signoff
- 2025-11-15: GA rollout and billing switch-over
